title: Activation-Conditioned Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2609.38342v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy self-distillation uses a model as its own teacher to provide dense supervision for reasoning, often through reference-solution conditioning. Providing privileged information does not by itself ensure effective token-level supervision throughout long responses. We introduce Activation-Conditioned Self-Distillation (ACSD), which extracts a steering vector by contrasting activations of self-generated trajectories that reach verified correct answers within a generation budget with those of all remaining trajectories. A frozen copy of the base model applies this vector at each prediction position, and the student learns from its next-token distributions on student-generated prefixes. Outcome verification is used for direction construction and calibration; distillation requires neither problem-specific reference text nor teacher parameter updates. translated_abstract: 在策略自蒸馏让模型充当自己的教师，为推理提供密集监督，通常通过参考解答条件化的方式实现。然而，提供特权信息本身并不能确保在整个长回答过程中获得有效的词元级监督。我们提出了激活条件化自蒸馏（ACSD），该方法通过将在生成预算内达到经验证正确答案的自生成轨迹的激活与所有其余轨迹的激活进行对比，提取出一个引导向量。基础模型的冻结副本在每个预测位置应用该向量，学生模型从其在自身生成前缀上的下一个词元分布中学习。结果验证仅用于方向构建与校准；蒸馏过程既不需要针对具体问题的参考文本，也不需要教师参数更新。蒸馏得到的学生模型在推理时单独使用。在五个模型中的每一个上，ACSD 实现了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ACSD 通过对比成功与失败自生成轨迹的激活差异提取引导向量，并利用冻结的基础模型副本在每个预测位置施加该向量来指导学生模型学习，从而无需参考文本或教师参数更新即可实现高效的自蒸馏。
en_tdlr: ACSD extracts a steering vector by contrasting activations of self-generated trajectories that reach verified correct answers against all others, and a frozen copy of the base model applies it at every prediction position to teach the student, achieving effective self-distillation without reference text or teacher parameter updates.
